cause: Training/serving skew on f2 caused by a missing log transform in the serving path. On the 200 shared entities, f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (MAD=0, corr=1.0), but f2 diverges (train mean 2.15 vs serve mean 10.03, corr 0.878). The relationship is exact: serve_f2 = exp(train_f2) - 1 = expm1(train_f2) (corr(serve_f2, exp(train_f2))=1.0, bias=-1.0). In other words the training pipeline computes f2 = log1p(raw) while the online service serves the raw (expm1) value without applying the log1p transform, so the model receives f2 on a completely different scale at serving time.
